profile.summary: Benchmark School is a small private special-education school for boys in grades 7 through 12 in Woods Cross, Utah. It operates on the campus of Benchmark Behavioral Health System, a residential treatment program for adolescent males, and works with students' home school districts to deliver Individualized Education Programs.

review.notes: Private School Review's Benchmark School (nonsectarian special education school, grades 7-12, Woods Cross UT) shares the address and website bbhsnet.com with Benchmark Behavioral Health System, whose home page describes Benchmark School as its accredited school; this matches the agenda's Woods Cross UT special education nonpublic school contract. Summary, phone, address, website and headquarters are supported by the cited pages and the summary is neutral.
